claims.claim: Rendering is CPU-bound, so the worker runs one render at a time per core (concurrency: 1).
claims.about: Node.js worker rendering PDFs with pdfkit and chartjs-node-canvas
claims.why: None of the measurements cover PDF or chart rendering in Node, or how a Node worker scales with concurrency per core.

claims.claim: /tasks should stay fast during month end because rendering no longer runs in the API process.
claims.why: The benchmark measures Express alone and never measures its latency while a separate process does CPU-heavy rendering, so there is nothing to check this against.

claims.claim: Reports will still take a while to finish, since one worker renders them one at a time.
claims.why: This follows from the team's own 400 ms per report figure, and the measurements say nothing about PDF rendering throughput.
